summary: Tested Customer-wise Sales Dashboard Redesign feature. All features working correctly: Dashboard loads without React hooks errors, Customers tab shows QC and Retail vertical cards with correct summary data, clicking vertical cards opens modal with customer list, modal shows multi-select checkboxes for retailer comparison, selecting multiple retailers shows comparison chart/table, and Customer Details action button opens detailed customer P&L modal.
